arStrings.szText: Akarat is dead. Despair is spreading. And a {c_important}cult of death{/c} is opening the way to {c_important}Pandemonium{/c} itself. Find their {icon:Marker_Rupture_S14_Season,2.5}{c_important}Ruptures{/c} in {icon:Marker_Helltide,2.2}Helltides and {icon:Marker_NightmareDungeonEntrance,2.5}Nightmare Dungeons, push back their {c_important}Risen Monsters{/c}, and bring down their {icon:Marker_Realm_Walker_S14,2.5}{c_important}Realmwalkers{/c} to face what lurks in Pandemonium.
